description: This file defines the MailMergeController class for handling mail merge search operations within the SuiteCRM project. It appears to manage search requests, process query parameters, and respond with JSON-encoded search results, particularly for modules like Contacts, Leads, and CampaignProspects.

classes.name: MailMergeController
classes.description: A controller class extending SugarController to handle AJAX search requests for mail merge functionality within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the MailMergeController, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: action_search
methods.description: Handles AJAX search requests for various modules, constructs database queries based on request parameters, retrieves relevant records, and returns the results in JSON format.
